subject: Pinecrest attestation onboarding and log handover
messages:
From: Alex Reed <alex@pinecrest.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: security@pinecrest.com
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Redwood attestation and log extracts — onboarding

Hi Tessa / Ben,

Thanks again for the quick intro yesterday. Pinecrest is starting our vendor attestation window and we need a short onboarding call to align on the evidence handoff for SOC 2 / SIG items. Primary asks for the first pass:

- Short overview of what extracts you can provide (auth logs, API access logs, infra config) and the retention windows.
- A timeline for log pulls (we typically need a 90-day window).
- Who at Redwood will be the technical owner for transfer and any SFTP/Share access details.

We have an external auditor (KCAudit) joining after initial intake, but for scheduling we wanted an internal Redwood tech and someone from your security/compliance team. Can you propose a 30–45 min slot this week or early next?

Attached: example vendor evidence checklist from Pinecrest (we'll share the full questionnaire once intake is confirmed).

Thanks,
Alex Reed
Head of IT Security — Pinecrest Health
alex@pinecrest.com
Attachment: pinecrest-vendor-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reed <alex@pinecrest.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood attestation and log extracts — onboarding

Alex — thanks for the note and the checklist. I can lead the intake and scope; Ben will be our logs/ops lead and Olga will coordinate evidence packaging and Doc/attestation drafts.

Proposed agenda (30 min):
1)Quick intro / scope confirmation (5 min)
2)What extracts Redwood can provide and formats (10 min)
3)Transfer method & timelines (5 min)
4)Next steps & owners (10 min)

Availability: Tue 12/2 10:00–11:00 PT, Wed 12/3 14:00–15:00 PT, Thu 12/4 09:00–10:00 PT. Please pick one that works and I will send a calendar invite with a short prep packet.

On extracts: we typically can provide auth logs, API request logs (token/anonized IDs), and audit events as CSV/TSV. For secure transfer we prefer S3 presigned URLs or a secure Drive folder; if you require SFTP we can accommodate with a scheduled window. We will also include a small sample extract (~48 hours) before the broader 90-day pull so your auditor can sanity-check schema.

Attaching our internal extract example for your reference.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Compliance Program Manager — Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0186
Attachment: redwood-extracts-20261201.tsv (sample extracts)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reed <alex@pinecrest.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-02T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood attestation and log extracts — onboarding

Alex, quick technical follow-up —

We can do the 90-day pull and produce: auth.log (timestamp, user_id_hash, action, source_ip), api_access.csv (timestamp, endpoint, status_code, request_size), and event_audit.tsv (event_type, actor_hash, resource_path).

Few clarifications we need from Pinecrest before the pull:
- Exact SIEM time window (UTC start/end).
- Preferred transfer method (S3 presigned link OR SFTP). If SFTP, we'll need host key add and a temporary account window.
- Any specific fields you need redacted (we will hash PII fields by default).

Also attaching the network topology diagram that lists our edge load balancers and regional egress points — this helps map retained logs to systems.

Proposed owners:
- Logs pull & transfer: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com)
- Evidence packaging & attestation doc: Olga Petrov (olga_petrov@redwood.com)
- Intake/coordination: Tessa Morgan

On the meeting: Wed 12/3 14:00 PT works for us. Please confirm and we'll send calendar invite with the dial-in.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Site Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference
Attachment: network-topology-v2.pdf (diagram)

From: Alex Reed <alex@pinecrest.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: security@pinecrest.com, KCAudit <auditor@kc-audit.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood attestation and log extracts — onboarding

Thanks Tessa / Ben — Wed 12/3 14:00 PT confirmed. I've looped in KCAudit (auditor@kc-audit.com) so they can observe the intake; they won't need access yet.

Answers to Ben's clarifications:
- SIEM window: 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z through 2026-11-30T23:59:59Z (UTC).
- Transfer method: S3 presigned link preferred; we will provide a secure bucket and short-lived role if needed.
- Redaction: please hash user identifiers and strip any free-text PII in request bodies.

I also uploaded our full questionnaire to the Drive link below — it includes a few SIG/CAT items we may surface during the call. If you want, add an initial attestation draft to the same folder so our legal team can pre-review.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPinecrestEvidence
DocuSign (attestation template we'll use): https://app.docusign.com/1234-attachment-sign

See you on Wed.

Alex Reed
Head of IT Security — Pinecrest Health
